title: Building pi in a World of Slop — Mario Zechner
summary: Mario Zechner explains why he built pi, a minimal coding agent, out of frustration with existing agent harnesses. He also discusses how AI agents are straining open source projects and argues for slowing down.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a first-hand argument for building your own lean agent harness instead of relying on bloated, vendor-controlled ones.

quote.text: There is a really good video by the author of pi.dev
